structured.answer: This page only explains what each kind of saving is. It has no numbers, nothing on what each pays or what the bank charges. So I'm staying with my deposit and will ask my son or the bank about government bonds (אג"ח ממשלתיות) and "מק"מ", which sound safe; the share index funds are not for me.

stuck.why: The three suggestions are for employees (שכירים) or a 'קרן כספית' I don't know; nothing for a retired person with deposits
It's called a 'קרן נאמנות' (scary to me) but also says 'סיכון נמוך'; couldn't decide if it is safe
Wanted it for grandchildren but it doesn't say whether a grandparent can add money
English letters and shares (MSCI, S&P 500, נאסד"ק); felt it is not for me and stopped reading
